name: codex-orchestration
description: Score-routed native workers with persisted complexity, savings receipts, and outcome tracking.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration once for the current Codex chat with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. It scores each deliverable once and persists that immutable one-decimal score. Scores 1.0–4.9 use a dedicated native GPT-5.6 Terra / High executive that owns requirements, architecture, the mapped producer, verification, corrections, review, and acceptance; root Sol performs only scoring, preflight, complete evidence handoff, monitoring, and result relay. Scores 5.0–10.0 retain primary GPT-5.6 Sol / High executive ownership and fresh Sol / High review. Producer bands remain unchanged: 1.0–2.9 uses native GPT-5.6 Luna / Max, 3.0–5.0 uses native GPT-5.6 Terra / Medium, 5.1–6.5 uses native GPT-5.6 Terra / High, 6.6–7.9 uses native GPT-5.6 Sol / Medium, and 8.0–10.0 uses a separate native GPT-5.6 Sol / High implementer. Thus score 5.0 has a Terra / Medium producer and Sol / High executive. Activation authorizes the score-selected native roles without separate task or model authorization. Current-turn preflight checks only attempted roles; producer fallback moves upward through the existing ladder until primary Sol High executes as the terminal fallback, and an unavailable low-band Terra executive falls upward to Sol / High with a visible verified reason. Every descendant thread is registered for the unchanged three-line weekly savings receipt. Completed tasks show the actual executive, implementation, immutable score, and receipt. Only authoritative task_complete turns count; user-interrupted or redirected turn_aborted work is excluded. Direct Orchestration: ON for this chat and Orchestration: OFF for this chat markers preserve state only inside the current chat. Minimum-sufficient, token, and time checkpoints shape scope without overriding numeric bands. Scope growth beyond 4.9 escalates from Terra executive to root Sol without revising the persisted score. Worker interruptions force fresh primary routing. The first activation each local day audits DannyMac180/sol-advisor without automatic merges. Accepted fork changes finish on jessejaffe/codex-orchestration main.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” to use Terra / High executive ownership below 5.0 and Sol / High executive ownership at 5.0 or above.
